target.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow
target.body:
## What this adds

A repository-owned, repeatable automerge end-to-end harness that runs the production planner, executor, publisher, applicator, exact-head verdict, and comment-router merge before changes reach `main`.

GitHub and Codex are stateful simulators. The production CLIs, Git clone/fetch/checkout/commit/push, Corepack/pnpm install, artifact-only job handoff, token separation, validation, exact-head binding, squash merge, and idempotent replay run for real against a tiny target repository.

## Local and CI entrypoints

```bash
pnpm e2e:automerge:container
pnpm e2e:automerge:container -- --scenario planning-head-drift
pnpm e2e:automerge -- --list-scenarios
```

The container uses Node 24.13.0 and a versioned Docker Hub base pinned by digest. It is capped at 8 GiB with no additional swap and 1024 PIDs. Git, Python, CA certificates, and Corepack live in the reusable base, while project dependencies remain a lockfile-keyed layer.

Published base:

`masonxhuang/clawsweeper-automerge-e2e-base:node24.13.0-bookworm-20260718@sha256:26a4e98237cc595b10166b27fc3e6342e805fed0446602e1960357ef6f82bba2`

The outer container keeps its default root user so the production validator can create its nested user/mount namespace. Target commands still start only after the validator drops every capability. The wrapper does not use privileged mode or add capabilities, and it restores artifacts to the invoking host UID afterward.

`.github/workflows/automerge-e2e.yml` runs all six scenarios on the production-class Blacksmith execution runner for relevant repair, harness, package-manager, and workflow changes. Untrusted fork pull requests do not receive that runner.

## Historical before/after proof

The `ci-regression-29623139111` scenario reconstructs [Actions job 88022196284](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29623139111/job/88022196284) with a tiny real Git repository, Node 24.13.0, and pnpm 11.2.2. The root cause does not depend on the OpenClaw source graph.

To isolate the linked index-identity defect from the earlier Yarn-shim defect in the historical revision, a test-only Corepack proxy adds the missing `pnpm` selector. An index-stat mutator changes only Git's administrative stat cache; content and tree remain unchanged.

- Before, candidate `7be2e4915b4b1d9aa953ccfe359cea670a4616ec`: reproduces `target dependency setup mutated checkout identity`.
- After, current stack with the same mutation: completes edit, validation, push, exact-head verdict, squash merge, and replay.

## Scenarios

- happy path
- tracked dependency-setup mutation rejection
- pending checks becoming green
- planning-to-execution head drift
- stale exact-head verdict
- 2026-07-18 runtime-identity regression

## Validation

- [Blacksmith production automerge flow](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29635545577): all six scenarios passed and proof artifacts uploaded.
- Final local root-container run: 6/6 scenarios passed.
- Container/workflow contract tests: 5/5 passed.
- Repair tests: 924 passed, 3 environment skips.
- Changed coverage: 100% lines, 88.61% branches, 100% functions for the changed target.
- Full coverage: 77.74% lines, 73.41% branches, 86.00% functions.
- Build, all lint gates, format check, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Full unit run: 1331 passed, 1 environment skip; one unrelated 3-second runtime-budget timing assertion failed under load and passed 8/8 on immediate isolated rerun.

## Crabbox status

Direct AWS Crabbox has been attempted twice. Provider `aws`, lease `cbx_76e570182550` remained in SSH bootstrap for six minutes; provider `aws`, lease `cbx_cab52b2e734f` remained there for 2 minutes 21 seconds. Neither attempt started the repository command. Both leases were interrupted and confirmed cleaned up/released. Crabbox is therefore supported by the checked-in container entrypoint but is not claimed as a completed proof for this PR.

Stack 3/3. Base: `feature/automerge-production-fixes`.
